data.one_liner: Localizely SDK for Flutter enables Over-the-air translations update from Localizely cloud platform
data.what_it_does: Provides Over-the-Air translation updates and In-Context Editing for Flutter applications using Localizely cloud platform. Works with Flutter's gen_l10n approach and Flutter Intl IDE plugin.
use_when: You want to update translations over-the-air without releasing a new app version
You want to use In-Context Editing for real-time translation previews on real devices
Your project uses Flutter's gen_l10n or Flutter Intl / intl_utils
avoid_when: You do not use the Localizely cloud platform for translations
You prefer purely local offline translation management without remote sync
strengths: Enables In-Context Editing on real devices
Integrates seamlessly with gen_l10n and Flutter Intl
weaknesses: Requires a paid or configured Localizely cloud platform account
Requires specific localization generation setup and code changes
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency, running the generator command, updating MaterialApp localizations delegates and supported locales, and initializing the SDK with an SDK token and distribution ID.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard internationalization approach built into Flutter without external cloud services.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Type-safe localization for Flutter with custom file formats and no cloud dependency.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Easy localization for Flutter supporting JSON, CSV, and YAML files loaded locally or remotely.
